name: playwright-browser
description: Playwright browser automation for pages WebFetch cannot reach: JS-rendered exchanges, filings and anti-bot pages. Runs headless Chromium inside the sandbox.

playwright.description: Headless Chromium automation: navigate, snapshot the accessibility tree, click, type, extract text and download files.
playwright.instruction: Use for pages that require a browser: JS-rendered announcements, exchange search, login walls, or pages where WebFetch returns an empty shell. Prefer WebFetch for simple article pages; prefer Playwright when you must interact, paginate, or read rendered content.
